blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Mid Meadows. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Mid Meadows, Pitt Meadows: 6 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 33% on only 6 listed, too few to read as a market type. By listings that is number 3 of 5 Pitt Meadows communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Pitt Meadows total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Mid Meadows fell from 10 in June to 6 in October (−40.0%), and 9 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 20.7% of Pitt Meadows’s 29 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Mid Meadows?
Mid Meadows also had 10 condos and townhomes listed and 4 sold in October, against 6 houses listed. The Mid Meadows condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Mid Meadows home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

18 houses sold in Mid Meadows with a median price of $1,190,000 (the middle half sold between $1,120,000 and $1,322,750), taking a median of 16 days to sell at 97.8% of the last list price; 11% sold above list. They had a median $559 per square foot, a median year built of 1990 and a median lot of 5,976 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Mid Meadows?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 6 houses listed in Mid Meadows. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Mid Meadows a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Mid Meadows had a sales ratio of 33% on only 6 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Mid Meadows from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 9 houses sold in Mid Meadows over those 5 months, out of 46 in all of Pitt Meadows.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Mid Meadows?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Mid Meadows sell for?
faq.a: 18 houses sold in Mid Meadows between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,190,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Mid Meadows?
faq.a: The median was 16 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.8% of the last list price (11% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
